title: Senior Executive, Legal Counsel
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

About JLL
  
**JLL (NYSE:** JLL) is a leading professional services firm specializing in real estate and investment management. A Fortune 500 company with annual revenue of $20 billion, operations in over 80 countries, and a global workforce of more than 115,000 as of 2025\.
  
  

What This Job Involves
  
We are seeking a Senior Executive – Legal Counsel to assist our legal team in contract management and compliance for all JLL entities. You will manage legal aspects of company contracts, provide expert guidance on labor\-related matters, and support risk management initiatives.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Contract Management \& Advisory
  
Provide legal guidance on contract\-related matters, including interpretation, terms and conditions, risk assessment, and dispute resolution
  
Review, draft, and negotiate contracts including Engagement Letters, fee letters, leasing agreements, Strategic Consulting agreements, and RFPs
  
Draft and negotiate legal documents for India, Sri Lanka \& Bangladesh
  
Undertake contracting monitoring activities
  
  

Labour \& Employment Law Advisory
  
Provide legal guidance on labour\-related issues and employment legislation
  
Suggest strategies to address changes in laws, regulations, and employment legislation
  
Conduct legal research on labour laws and provide insights on organizational impacts
  
Maintain accurate records and prepare reports on labour matters
  
  

Compliance \& Risk Management
  
Mitigate legal risk by implementing legal strategy and exploring new legal regimes
  
Assess compliance incidents and direct non\-compliance issues to appropriate functions
  
Detect legal risks and contractual liabilities and provide advice on non\-compliance issues
  
Maintain repository for tracking and reporting legal incidents to management
  
Study legal notifications, circulars, and amendments, and advise on applicability
  
Review and advice on AI\-related clauses in commercial agreements in accordance with regulatory requirements
  
  

Stakeholder Management
  
Advise stakeholders on legal issues and navigate the evolving compliance landscape
  
Support all business lines on legal and contracting matters
  
Establish cordial relationships with directors and stakeholders
  
Bring efficiency in terms of costs and productivity
  
  

**Sounds Like You? To Apply You Need:**  

Education \& Experience
  
Bachelors/ Master's in Law degree from a recognized institution
  
3\-5 years of post\-qualification experience in a contracting or advisory role
  
  

Technical Knowledge
  
Understanding of contracting systems and identifying potential legal risks
  
Knowledge of compliance management, data privacy, anti\-bribery and corruption, anti\-money laundering, cybersecurity, workplace harassment, intellectual property, and corporate governance
  
Knowledge of Contract Act, Labour laws (including new labour codes), Insolvency Code, Stamp Act, Registration Act, etc.
  
Experience in drafting and vetting contracts
  
Awareness of AI governance frameworks, emerging AI regulations, and ethical considerations in AI deployment
  
Understanding of AI\-related contractual provisions including data usage, liability allocation, and intellectual property rights in AI\-generated content
  
  

Skills \& Competencies
  
Proficiency in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills
  
Strong analytical skills to analyze and opine on statutory provisions
  
Ability to conduct legal research and handle business relationships
  
Ability to assess legal and compliance risks associated with AI technologies and automation
  
Adaptability to emerging legal frameworks governing AI, machine learning, and generative AI applications
  
Willingness to travel within India for official work
  
  

What We Can Do For You
  
At JLL, you will realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. You will work with a highly skilled and experienced dynamic legal team with platforms to enrich your technical domains, including exposure to cutting\-edge AI and technology\-driven legal solutions. We offer competitive pay and benefits through our Total Rewards Program. JLL has been recognized by the Ethisphere Institute as one of the 2025 World's Most Ethical Companies for the 18th consecutive year.
  
  

Apply Today!
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Executive – Legal & Statutory Affairs
description:
**About Medhavi Skills University**
Medhavi Skills University (MSU) is a government\-notified private State Skills University established under a State Act in Sikkim in 2021, dedicated to advancing quality skill\-integrated higher education and entrepreneurship. Recognised by the UGC and aligned with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, MSU is a pioneer in converging the skilling ecosystem with formal higher education through its “Industry as Campus” model. The University collaborates extensively with industries and Skill Development Institutes to deliver work\-integrated degree programs embedding structured on\-the\-job training within the curriculum. MSU is a recognised Awarding Body under NCVET, empanelled with DGT, and serves as an anchor university partner with NSDC and the PMU of NSDC International\-collectively reinforcing its demand\-driven, industry\-co\-led academic framework. Ranked 4th among India’s Top Skill Universities in the Outlook ICARE Rankings 2025 and supported by over 11 defence partnerships along with multiple national recognitions, MSU stands among India’s leading skill\-integrated higher education institutions.  

For more information, visit https://msu.edu.in **About Medhavi Group:**
Established in 2013, Medhavi Group is a unified ecosystem comprising MSU and various skill\-promoting organisations, dedicated to advancing skill development, vocational training, and industry\-integrated higher education. With a strong outcome\-driven approach, the Group has trained over 6 lakh learners, achieving more than 70% employability outcomes, and currently supports 20,000\+active students across its diverse programs. Medhavi Group continues to bridge the gap between education and employment by building scalable, industry\-aligned talent pathways across India. Work Integrated Skill based Higher Education (WISE) is Medhavi’s flagship industry\-integrated initiative built on the principle of “Industry as Campus.” It combines academic learning with structured on\-the\-job training, ensuring students graduate with real work experience and industry\-ready skills. Through deep, outcome\-driven partnerships with over 300\+ leading industry and skill partners across 26\+ sectors including Hyundai, Mahindra, IHG Group, Nephroplus, Barbeque Nation, Nexus Select Malls, ClassPlus, Tata Electronics, Marriott, ITC, and others\- WISE enables learners to acquire role\- specific competencies directly within live business environments. WISE creates a demand\-driven talent pipeline for industries that enhances employability, improves workforce productivity, and bridges the industry skill gap.  

For more information, visit https://msu.edu.in/wise **Role Overview:**
The Executive – Legal \& Regulatory Affairs will support the Legal Department in contract drafting and review, legal research, regulatory compliance, documentation, legal correspondence and day\-to\-day legal advisory requirements of the organisation. The role will involve coordination with internal
business teams and external stakeholders to ensure timely closure of legal and contractual matters while managing associated legal and regulatory risks. **Key Responsibilities:** **A. Contract Drafting \& Review*** Draft, review and revise various commercial and legal documents, including MoUs, agreements,
* NDAs, service agreements, partnership agreements, addendums, engagement letters and other contractual documents.
* Review agreements received from business partners and identify legal, commercial and regulatory risks.
* Incorporate business and commercial inputs into legal documents and coordinate with stakeholders for closure.
* Maintain and update standard legal templates.

**B. Legal Research \& Advisory Support*** Conduct legal research on applicable laws, rules, regulations, notifications, circulars and judicial decisions.
* Assist senior members of the Legal Department in providing legal opinions and responses tobusiness queries.
* Track relevant legal and regulatory developments affecting the organisation’s operations.
* Prepare legal notes, issue summaries and internal advisory communications.

**C. Regulatory \& Compliance Support*** Assist in monitoring compliance with applicable statutory, regulatory and sector\-specific requirements.
* Support the Legal Department in matters involving regulatory authorities and statutory bodies.
* Maintain records of regulatory approvals, registrations, licences, filings and other relevant documentation.
* Assist in identifying potential regulatory risks and escalating material issues to seniormanagement.

**D. Legal Notices \& Dispute Support*** Assist in drafting legal notices, replies, representations, demand letters and other legal correspondence.
* Support the Legal Department in managing disputes, claims and litigation\-related matters.
* Coordinate with external advocates/counsels and maintain records of ongoing legal matters.
* Assist in preparing documents and information required for legal proceedings.

**E. Contract Management \& Documentation*** Maintain an organised repository of executed and pending agreements.
* Track contract status, expiry dates, renewal timelines, termination notices and other contractualobligations.
* Follow up with relevant stakeholders for execution, stamping, notarisation and other documentation requirements, wherever applicable.
* Ensure proper documentation and record\-keeping of legal transactions.

**F. Internal Stakeholder Coordination*** Coordinate with Business, Operations, Finance, HR, Compliance and other functions on legal requirements.
* Ensure that legal matters are appropriately documented and escalated where required.
* Assist in developing internal legal processes, SOPs, checklists and compliance mechanisms.

**G. General Legal Support*** Assist in due diligence exercises, vendor/partner onboarding and background documentation.
* Support the preparation of management reports.
* Undertake other legal and regulatory assignments as may be allocated by the reporting manager.

 **Qualifications \& Skills Required:*** LL.B. / B.A. LL.B. / B.B.A. LL.B. from a recognised institution.
* 1–2 years of relevant experience in a corporate legal department, law firm or in\-house legal function.
* Prior experience in contract drafting, agreement review and legal research will be preferred.
* Experience in the education, skilling, training, technology or services sector will be an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of basic principles of contract law and commercial agreements.
* Good legal drafting and reviewing skills.
* Strong legal research and analytical abilities.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to identify contractual and regulatory risks.

 **What We Offer*** Opportunity to architect and scale a future\-focused, industry\-integrated higher education ecosystem.
* Competitive compensation with performance\-linked incentives.
* Leadership role in a rapidly growing national skills and university platform.
* A collaborative, mission\-driven environment.
* The opportunity to create a measurable impact on employability and workforce transformation at scale.

 **How to Apply**
Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter detailing their qualifications and experience at careers@msu.edu.in at earliest possible.
Medhavi Skills University is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Company Secretary
description:
We are seeking a qualified Company Secretary to manage corporate compliance, secretarial functions, corporate governance, statutory filings, Board and shareholder matters, and coordination with legal advisors, auditors, regulators, and senior management.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, Rules, and applicable corporate laws.
* Monitor statutory changes and assess their impact on the Company.
* Prepare and file ROC, MCA, and other statutory forms, returns, and disclosures.
* Maintain statutory registers, secretarial records, and documentation.
* Ensure timely annual and event\-based filings.
* Coordinate with statutory authorities and regulators.
* Maintain the compliance calendar.

2\. Board \& Shareholder Management

* Organize Board Meetings, Committee Meetings, and General Meetings.
* Prepare agendas, notices, explanatory statements, and supporting documents.
* Draft and finalize Board and shareholder resolutions.
* Prepare and maintain meeting minutes.
* Ensure compliance with meeting timelines, quorum, and voting requirements.
* Maintain records of directors, Board composition, and committees.

3\. Corporate Governance

* Support sound corporate governance practices.
* Ensure compliance with related\-party transaction requirements.
* Maintain director and Key Managerial Personnel disclosures.
* Monitor conflicts of interest and governance matters.

4\. Fundraising \& Corporate Transactions

* Support equity and debt fundraising transactions.
* Handle secretarial documentation for private placements, rights issues, preferential allotments, share transfers, securities issuance, and ESOPs.
* Support investments, acquisitions, due diligence, and corporate restructuring.
* Maintain capitalization tables and shareholding records.

5\. Legal Documentation \& RBI Compliance

* Coordinate implementation of Shareholders' Agreements, Share Subscription Agreements, Investment Agreements, ESOP documentation, and other corporate agreements.
* Track contractual obligations and compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with external legal counsel.
* Support RBI/FEMA\-related compliances, foreign investment filings, and coordination with Authorized Dealer Banks, wherever applicable.

6\. Audit \& Compliance Monitoring

* Coordinate with Secretarial Auditors, Statutory Auditors, Internal Auditors, and legal advisors.
* Support due diligence and audit documentation.
* Track and close audit observations.
* Maintain compliance trackers and escalate potential compliance gaps.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Qualified Company Secretary (Member of ICSI).
* 1\-2 years of relevant post\-qualification experience.
* Experience in a CS Firm, startup, private equity/venture capital\-backed company, or high\-growth organization is preferred.
* Additional qualification in Law/LLB is an advantage.
* Exposure to fundraising, investor documentation, SHA/SSA, ESOP, and RBI compliance is an advantage.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013\.
* Understanding of corporate governance and Board processes.
* Strong drafting and documentation skills.
* Ability to interpret legal and commercial agreements.
* Good stakeholder management and communication skills.
* High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deadlines.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Timely statutory and secretarial filings.
* Timely conduct of Board, Committee, and Shareholder Meetings.
* Accuracy of Board minutes and resolutions.
* Effective compliance calendar management.
* Timely closure of audit and compliance observations.

**How to Apply:** Interested candidates may share their updated CV with **jobs@souave.com**.

Work Location: In person
